result.description:
Employer - Evolution Hospitality Institute


Position  : Full Time
Location : Sydney NSW
Salary     : $79,000 - $89,000 a year
  

Located in Sydney CBD, the award-winning Evolution Hospitality Institute is a leader in Hospitality and Education provides a modern learning environment that encourages growth, allows for diversity, and embeds skills and knowledge for industry professionals. They aim to be at the forefront in Education, setting the benchmark for the International and Local training sectors.
  
Evolution Hospitality Institute (Evolution-Systems For Training & Development Pty Ltd) is seeking a hardworking and dedicated Computer Network Systems Engineer to join their team.
  
Skills, Duties, and Responsibilities:
Design, implement, configure, and maintain the institute's wired and wireless network infrastructure across campuses.
Install, configure, monitor, and maintain network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and VPN solutions.
Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilisation, and system availability to ensure maximum uptime and reliability.
Troubleshoot and resolve network, server, internet, and connectivity issues for staff, students, and administrative systems.
Plan, implement, and maintain cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, intrusion prevention, access controls, and security policies.
Perform regular system updates, software patching, backups, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity planning.
Evaluate existing network infrastructure and recommend improvements to enhance performance, scalability, and security.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including network diagrams, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and maintenance records.
Monitor network traffic, system logs, and security events to identify vulnerabilities and respond to incidents promptly.
Ensure compliance with organisational ICT policies, privacy requirements, and information security standards.
Research emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions that improve operational efficiency and the digital learning experience.
  
Skills, Qualification and Experience :
Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, or a suitable relevant qualification.
At least 2-3 years of relevant experience.
Strong knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching technologies.
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, including firewalls, endpoint protection, multi-factor
Ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise network performance using network management and monitoring tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
Strong organisational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and complying with organisational ICT policies and information security standards.
  

If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Document incident findings and recommend remediation actions to reduce security risks.  Support incident response activities and coordinate remediation efforts where required.    Vulnerability and Patch Management    Perform vulnerability assessments across endpoints, infrastructure, and application environments.  Identify and track security vulnerabilities across systems, repositories, and network infrastructure.  Assist in patch management and remediation processes to reduce exposure to security threats.    Security Infrastructure and Platform Administration    Implement, configure, and maintain security tools and platforms, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), and cloud security monitoring tools such as AWS Security Hub.  Monitor the security posture of cloud and internal environments to ensure systems remain secure and compliant.  Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for security platform maintenance and improvements.    Governance, Risk and Compliance    Assist in developing and maintaining information security policies, procedures, and standards.  Support implementation and maintenance of security frameworks, including ISO 27001.  Maintain security documentation, operational runbooks, and audit evidence to support compliance requirements.  Conduct security risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.    Security Awareness and Training    Deliver cybersecurity awareness training programs across the organisation.  Promote security best practices and assist in maintaining security awareness platforms and training materials.    Continuous Security Improvement    Conduct periodic security reviews of systems and infrastructure.  Recommend improvements to strengthen security controls and operational resilience.  Evaluate emerging security technologies and tools to enhance organisational security capabilities.    Required Skills    Cybersecurity monitoring and incident investigation  Vulnerability assessment and remediation  Cloud security monitoring and infrastructure security  Security platform administration (EDR, UEM, cloud security tools)  Compliance platform administration  Risk assessment and security control implementation  Information security governance and compliance  Security documentation and policy development    Qualifications and Experience    Master’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.  Experience working in information security, cybersecurity operations, or security risk management roles.  Experience with security monitoring tools, vulnerability management, and cloud environments is desirable.  Relevant certifications are advantageous   About Company    Beforepay, an ASX-listed fintech pioneer, is on a mission to revolutionise the financial industry with safe and affordable products. Our core philosophy is grounded in providing ethical short-term loans as a viable alternative to predatory lending practices. This commitment to integrity and customer well-being has earned us prestigious accolades such as the Ethical Lender of the Year 2023 by Wealth & Finance International FinTech Awards and Global Pan Finance Awards, and the Best App-Based Lending Company 2023 in Australia by APAC Insider Business Awards.  Our journey of innovation and ethical service was further recognised with our inclusion in the Tech Fast 50 2023 by Deloitte and our early accolade as the Ashurst FinTech Startup of the Year in 2020. As a team member of Beforepay, you'll join a trailblazing company that not only sets the pace in the fintech industry but also upholds the highest standards of ethical lending, providing a meaningful and impactful career. result.description:
Cortex Customer Success Architects are responsible for empowering our clients to  prevent successful cyberattacks as well as simplify and strengthen security processes, automate and streamline security operations and attack surface management, the team is built by highly technical professionals that work together with customers, partners, and their awesome colleagues. Without these ninjas, we will fail. And failure is not an option!

Your Impact

Time to value - Provide guidance and assistance to the team to enable effective customer deployment and customization of their XDR / XSIAM platform throughout the customer lifecycle to ensure quick and successful product deployment and adoption

Product Experts - Ensure the team acts as the product SME, assisting customers with their product questions and technical requirements, writing scripts, troubleshooting, training and other technical requests.

Collaboration - working together with product and engineering teams ensuring our customers and partners get the most out of our products

Digital First - Ensure technical knowledge of the team is translated into articles and guides for our customers to consume allowing our customer coverage to scale


Qualifications

Experience with development and maintenance of scripts in Python. 
JavaScript or PowerShell is a plus
Experience in security design and architecture, content development and  workload automation.
Experienced with technologies such as EDR, SIEM, SOAR, NGFW and their ecosystems
Familiarity with cloud technologies, providers (such as GCP, AWS, Azure) and use-cases.
Familiarity with attack surface management is a plus
Experience as a Security Incident Responder or SOC analyst/manager
Experience in customer-facing roles is a must
Ability to work under pressure, and prioritize tasks accordingly
Fluent English is a requirement. Any other language is a plus
